channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: People of Purpose: How Dr. Mahantesh G. Kivadasannavar Built Samarthanam Trust and Made Blind Cricket a National Movement
item.description: Blinded at six months, Dr. Mahantesh built Samarthanam from 400 sq ft room to nationwide empowerment for disabled Indians.

item.title: Air India’s AI916D Brings Back 149 Passengers From Dubai Amid Middle East Crisis
item.description: The first Indian carrier to land in Delhi during the West Asia airspace disruptions safely brought back 149 passengers under heightened security coordination.

item.title: 4.3 Magnitude Earthquake Shakes Iran’s Gerash Region Amid Intensifying US-Israel Conflict
item.description: Moderate 4.3 magnitude quake hit Iran’s Gerash during rising Iran–Israel–US tensions, but no casualties or major damage.

item.title: Delhi Resident Wins Over ₹1 Lakh After Consumer Court Penalises Malaysia Airlines & MakeMyTrip
item.description: Delhi resident wins refund and compensation after COVID-19 flight cancellations, exposing travel portal and airline service lapses

item.title: US-Israel-Iran War Update: US Closes Gulf Embassies as UAE Shoots Down Scores of Missiles and Drones
item.description: Civilians flee as Israel issues evacuation orders for nearly 60 Lebanese locations and heavy airstrikes kill dozens amid intensifying hostilities with Hezbollah.

item.title: Logical Take: Between Fear and Foresight – Is Humanity Waiting for Catastrophe to Choose Peace?
item.description: As global tensions rise, humanity faces a choice: engineer cooperation proactively or wait for catastrophe to force peace.

item.title: Mojtaba Khamenei Reportedly Becomes Iran’s Supreme Leader After Historic 47-Year Leadership Transition
item.description: Iran’s Assembly of Experts reportedly appoints Mojtaba Khamenei as Supreme Leader amid regional conflict and constitutional transition.

item.title: Delhi Court Orders ₹65,802 Refund, Penalises MakeMyTrip in Covid Flight Cancellation Case
item.description: Delhi consumer forum holds Malaysia Airlines, MakeMyTrip liable for refund delays, awards compensation.

item.title: 8 Million Indians At Stake? Rahul Gandhi Questions PM Modi’s Silence On Iran Crisis
item.description: India’s Opposition urges the Prime Minister to define India’s stance after reports of Khamenei’s assassination sparked concern and debate.

item.title: Trump Threatens to Cut Off All Trade With Spain After Refusal to Use Military Bases in Iran Strike
item.description: Trump warns of a full trade embargo on Spain after Madrid denied U.S. base access for Iran strikes.
